repeated_reference_handling.method: Each source leaf has one unique leaf_id based on exactly one (revision,path,pointer); multiple candidates may reference that ID. Same leaf referenced by multiple requirements/cases is not copied into multiple leaf records.
repeated_reference_handling.known_repeated_prose: L4 /contracts/0..5 have distinct behavior/backflow pointers. Repeated boilerplate backflow remains separate source leaves; value_sha256 reveals byte-equivalent normalized values where applicable.
repeated_reference_handling.cross_layer_overlap: The L3 requirement, L10 case, and L4 contract can support the same provisional meaning but remain distinct source leaves with independent pointers.

same_value_distinct_pointer_groups.meaning: Distinct source leaves; value equality does not merge leaf identity.

repeated_reference_handling.facet_deduplication: Each source leaf has one canonical_destination. Its primary facet candidate and all possible propagation facets are listed once; propagated effects do not create duplicate source findings. If multiple primary facets or multiple independent negative inputs prevent a unique finding identity, code/atomization remain unknown.

unresolved: Actual classification_code, ordered finding_codes, backflow owner, and typed owner_ref cannot be established from the permitted L3/L10 and L4 prose sources alone.
Axis/state are kept unknown at candidate level because grouped source leaves span multiple axes/states and no actual six-field key may be asserted.
Whether any provisional candidates correspond to, split, or merge with existing classifications remains unanswered.
No permitted source uniquely specifies generated finding codes or the six-field class key.
Some source leaves bundle multiple negative inputs; their internal finding atomization cannot be fixed without a more granular authorized source pointer or additional approved design.

hash_method.leaf_value_sha256: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes of compact canonical JSON serialization of the JSON Pointer value: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")); arrays retain source order; object keys sort lexicographically; no trailing newline.
hash_method.file_sha256: SHA-256 over exact raw bytes returned by git show <revision>:<path>, no normalization.
hash_method.verification_source: Every source leaf was re-resolved by its source.revision and source.path using git show, then its pointer value was canonicalized and hashed by the method above.

revision_note: For every citation, source.revision is the Git commit actually used with git show (dd07a3498be74f32519adf42a221caf51e547ea1). source.content_revision records document-internal source/content revision metadata separately; it is not a Git object lookup target.

hash_verification.method: hash_method.leaf_value_sha256 for JSON pointer values; hash_method.file_sha256 for Markdown file.
